The queen reigns supreme in a Yoruba adaptation of Macbeth that’s both fascinating and clumsy
Crown of Blood is edge-of-the-seat spectacle theatre.
Utopia Theatre makes a triumphant return to the Crucible stage with their Crown of Blood.

This is the world premiere of Crown of Blood , a powerful retelling of Shakespeare's Macbeth set during the civil wars of 19th-century Yorubaland. General Aderemi, fresh from saving the kingdom from invaders, is promoted to Field Marshal, thus fulfilling the prophecy of the oracle.
Kehinde Bankole, an award winning Nigerian actress, takes on the role of Aderemi’s wife Oyebisi.
Crown of Blood is a thought-provoking piece of theatre that reimagines a familiar story now deeply rooted in a new cultural setting.
